description: This Java class 'AuthService' provides authentication functionalities including user registration and login, issuing JWT tokens upon successful authentication, in the context of a Spring Boot application.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Service class responsible for user authentication, registration, and JWT token issuance.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user with specified username, email, password, and role, then returns a JWT token.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates user with username and password, returning a JWT token if successful.
